suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented breast-cancer treatment with relevant lymphatic disruption/exposure (for example axillary node surgery and/or regional radiotherapy) and separately documented lymphedema. Do not infer lymphedema from breast cancer alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
